question: Who fallen elsewhere is graced here upward, and who fallen is sometimes led?
premises: therefore also supreme Shaiva — who elsewhere fallen, he indeed here to be graced
upward and upward, but of the guide
inference: Elsewhere-fallen graced upward here; sometimes even the fallen guide is led.
uncertainties: anugrahya reading kept per gloss; independent verification pending
plain_english: Therefore also supreme Shaiva — who elsewhere fallen, he indeed here to be graced; upward and upward, but of the guide, fallen sometimes.
